_policy: Regression floors, pinned at the first full run (2026-11-25) minus a small tolerance. They catch regressions; they are not quality claims. Original pre-registered targets that were NOT met are listed in README 'Results' (groundedness 0.80, retrieval Recall@10 0.50, incident recall 0.70, aspect detection F1 0.60, silhouette 0.30).
